_comment: Where things sit in each cliff picture (<kit>.png, cut from originals/cliffs/<kit>.jpg), in picture pixels. pixelsPerUnit = picture pixels per world unit: the wall, from wallTop to wallBottom, is 128 units (2 tiles) tall. lipTop = where the grassy/stone lip above the wall starts. leftTip/rightTip = the outer tips of the lip on the left and right edges. sides = two stretches of plain wall (left and right of the steps) that the wall tiles are made from. stairs = the columns of the stairs sprite; stairsTop/stairsBottom its rows; notch = the columns of the gap the steps cut into the plateau. tools/prepare-generated-art.py and tools/build-map.py both read this file.
